issues: No prices anywhere in the document: every priceUsd is null.
The six ALL-CAPS dietary warning lines repeat after every page/section (10 times); stored once in footnotes.

Several items have a single name with no ' | ' (Club Sandwich, Katsu Sando, Hamburger, Cheeseburger, Penne All’arrabiata, Spaghetti Pomodoro, Fettucine Alfredo, Cheesecake): tr and en are both set to the printed name.

Some names/details use ' / ' instead of ' | ' as the TR/EN separator (El Yapımı Izgara Sucuk, Börek Tabağı detail, Yumurta Benedict detail, Smoothie Kâse/Yulaf Kâsesi/Musli details, Tiramisu, Chicken Fingers detail); split on it.
Typo kept verbatim in the Musli option line: 'HHHindistan cevizi sütü' (probably 'Hindistan cevizi sütü').
The Musli option line ('Tercihinize göre: ... süt ...') may apply to the whole Healthy Bowls category (milk choices for all bowls) but sits after Musli, so it was appended to Musli per the rule.

'Krep, Pancake ve Waffle' appears under TOSTLAR with only an option line (no description); the toast-wide note ('Tüm tost çeşitlerimiz...') comes after it, so it may or may not apply to the crepe item.
Sağlıklı Kahvaltı is a single item whose six component lines were joined with '; '; it sits inside KAHVALTI (after the first dietary-warning block), not as its own category.
Source text contains typographic ligatures (mufﬁn, Wafﬂe, Proﬁterol, Proﬁteroles, bonﬁle, ﬂaxseeds, ﬂax) which were normalized to plain letters (fi/fl).
'House - Made Fried Sausage' (EN) is printed with spaces around the hyphen; kept as printed, whereas other items use 'House-made'.

Spelling kept as printed: 'Spagetti Bolenez' (TR) vs 'Spaghetti Pomodoro'; 'Fettucine'; 'Güne Başlangıç Tabağı' uses 'siyah sele zeytin' while Classic uses 'Gemlik zeytin'; 'MAKARNA & RİSOTTO' EN heading prints 'RİSOTTO' with dotted İ.
'Yumurta Akından Omlet' with spinach/goat cheese description appears in BREAKFAST SIDE ORDERS, while 'Yumurta akından kuşkonmazlı omlet' is a component of Sağlıklı Kahvaltı; not duplicates.
Mantı (El Yapımı Mantı) appears after a page-break warning block but belongs to MAKARNA & RİSOTTO (no new heading); same for Cheeseburger/Füme Burger in SANDVİÇ & BURGER.
